selection: Maximize validation observed-positive micro recall subject to 99% full-vs-base C-index gain; if infeasible maximize validation C-index, then recall; flag infeasibility
budget_semantics: Fill affordable test budget using normalized OOF revision plus weighted expected observed-positive yield per marginal cost. No utility STOP; budget stopping only. Static comparators have identical test counts before guardrails.
external_transfer: Frozen weights and static rankings, intersect with external availability; budget capped at four tests; no external fitting
clinical_ancestry: For ADA only, Asian ancestry assumed from cohort context; not individually measured. Also report unknown-ancestry sensitivity. KZ158 does not enumerate high-risk ethnicities, so ethnicity is unassessed for both KZ cohort variants.
clinical_family_history: Dataset family history is not verified first-degree; excluded from cohort guardrails
guardrail_budget: FPG appended after policy if required; extra cost and budget exceedance reported; no repeat draw charge
lab_labels: Observed-only TC>=5.2, TG>=1.7 mmol/L; ALT>33 male or >25 female U/L; BUN>7.1 mmol/L internal only; CCR excluded
